claims.value: Dispute with the confraternity; settlement around 1506 to 1508
claims.statement: Documents of 1506 to 1508 record a dispute over payment and completion between the painters and the confraternity, and the completion of the picture to the confraternity's satisfaction in 1508. Document by document details (arbitration of 1506, payments of 1508) were not read in this session.

background.text: La seconda versione della Vergine delle Rocce è un dipinto a olio su tavola di Leonardo da Vinci, databile al 1494-1508 e conservato nella National Gallery di Londra. La prima versione del dipinto, databile al 1483-1486 circa, è invece al Museo del Louvre.

variants: The Virgin with the Infant Saint John the Baptist adoring the Christ Child accompanied by an Angel ('The Virgin of the Rocks')

timeline.text: Second version of the altarpiece for the Confraternity of the Immaculate Conception. The 1483 contract and the dispute of 1506 to 1508 are documented, the painting phases are a reconstruction.
timeline.basis: National Gallery dating; documents of 1483 and 1506 to 1508.
